reviewer_statement: Provisional developer-scoped native scientific artist geometry only. Direct public frozen Python 1.2 Matplotlib comparisons are authored but exact-head CI has not been observed green; independent full-domain certification remains zero.
native_language_semantic_policy: Scientific source plot geometry is represented by typed native R artist records with original default numerical R outputs unchanged; Python dataclass and Matplotlib Axes object identity is excluded.

case_evidence.description: Published eyetrajectoriespy 1.2.0 src/eyetrajectoriespy/plotting.py::plot_functional_random_effects inspected; strict_source_record=TRUE opt-in extends the native R plot while preserving original default base graphics and numerical output.

Validated source-shaped native R mixed BLUP or direct conformal p-value lists with positive integer limits and explicit IDs. Source conformal requires actual p_values and target_curve_ids rather than recomputing hidden scores. General Python dataclass identity, pandas grouping API, arbitrary Matplotlib Axes injection and exception-class identity remain outside bounded R domain.

Frozen Python participant random intercept/slope BLUP line artists with source order, alpha control, conditional <=12 legend, physical time axes and source title, y=0 dashed reference and first-n participant capping. Native source order/error cases, legacy default checks, and opt-in public frozen Python 1.2 Matplotlib differential artist assertions authored in a dedicated test file. Executable exact-head CI passing has not yet been observed.

Native R strict flag, integer max, unknown participant, invalid effect, missing random slope, malformed source array, and conformal p-value/flag identity validations reject incorrect inputs. R condition class is not asserted equal to Python TypeError, ValueError or KeyError.

Default base-R graphics and invisible R audit line/p-value geometry unchanged. Strict mode returns a typed etr_nonlinear_scientific_artist_record with original source artist data, axes, titles, conditional legends and source-only p-value provenance; not an actual Python matplotlib.axes.Axes or a pixel-equivalent figure.
Precomputed participant random intercept and slope functional BLUPs. No mixed-model parameter refit, predictor mixing, covariance estimation or participant averaging.

independent_review_status: Developer provisional bounded scientific source plot geometry; 0 independent certifications, exact-head R/Python CI unobserved.
language_specific_limits: Does not produce Python Matplotlib Axes/Figure objects, Python dataclass/pandas type protocols, exact Python error-class identity, pixel rendering or general Python ax injection.
Mixed effects parameters and functional BLUPs are already computed; source scientific artist review does not certify optimizer or covariance-family numerical equivalence.

Conformal strict mode demands direct original p_values; default reconstructed conservative native R results are a separate scientific interface and not silently passed off as frozen Python source dataclass fields.
